skill.name: slides
skill.description: Create responsive HTML presentation decks with Chart.js, reusable design tokens, persuasive copywriting formulas, and audience-specific slide strategies.
skill.summary: Build polished, data-driven HTML presentations for pitches, sales, reports, and talks.
skill.author: nextlevelbuilder

security_audit.summary: Two low-risk network behaviors are confirmed because generated presentations may load Chart.js and images from external hosts. The remaining 13 alerts are false positives caused by ordinary HTML, JavaScript property names, Markdown code formatting, and CSS terminology. No prompt injection or malicious intent was found.

remediation.issue: The HTML template loads Chart.js from a public CDN.
remediation.suggestion: Offer a locally bundled Chart.js option and document that the CDN requires network access.

remediation.issue: The background image example references an external image host.
remediation.suggestion: Prefer local image assets or require users to approve external image requests.

content.value_statement: Building persuasive, responsive presentations requires coordinated structure, design, copy, and data visualization. This skill turns a topic and audience brief into a complete HTML deck.
actual_capabilities: Creates complete HTML slide decks with keyboard, click, progress, and slide-counter navigation.
Selects layouts for titles, metrics, comparisons, timelines, teams, pricing, and calls to action.
Builds responsive 16:9 presentations with mobile and tablet breakpoints.
Adds line, bar, doughnut, or radar charts through Chart.js.
Applies pitch, sales, demo, workshop, board, and conference deck structures.
limitations: Produces HTML presentations, not native PowerPoint, Keynote, or Google Slides files.
External Chart.js and image URLs require network access unless replaced with local assets.
Source facts, metrics, testimonials, and financial claims still require user verification.
The skill provides templates and strategy guidance but does not include a browser rendering test.

use_cases.title: Prepare an investor pitch
use_cases.description: Turn company facts into a concise seed or Series A deck with traction, market, business model, and funding request slides.

use_cases.title: Build a persuasive sales deck
use_cases.description: Present customer pain, solution value, proof, pricing, objections, and next steps in a responsive format.

use_cases.title: Report performance clearly
use_cases.description: Convert quarterly metrics and priorities into charts, KPI layouts, comparisons, and an executive narrative.

prompt_templates.title: Create a simple deck
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a six-slide HTML presentation about [topic] for [audience]. Use a clear structure, concise copy, and responsive layouts.
prompt_templates.scenario: A beginner needs a complete presentation from a short brief.

prompt_templates.title: Build a sales presentation
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a nine-slide sales deck for [product]. Address [customer problem], include [proof], explain pricing, and end with [next step].
prompt_templates.scenario: A sales professional needs a persuasive customer presentation.

prompt_templates.title: Design a data-driven report
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a ten-slide quarterly review for [organization]. Visualize [metrics] with Chart.js and structure the narrative around results, risks, and priorities.
prompt_templates.scenario: A leader needs an executive report with meaningful charts.

prompt_templates.title: Develop an investor narrative
prompt_templates.prompt: Create a twelve-slide Series A deck for [company]. Use verified data, define the emotion arc, select varied layouts, and emphasize [investment thesis].
prompt_templates.scenario: A founder needs an advanced fundraising narrative with deliberate pacing.

output_examples.input: Create a six-slide product demo for a team scheduling platform.
output: A responsive presentation opens with the scheduling problem and a focused product promise.
Feature and workflow slides use varied layouts with concise benefits.
The deck closes with pricing context and a specific demonstration request.

output_examples.input: Build a quarterly review using revenue, retention, and pipeline data.
output: A KPI overview highlights the three primary metrics.
Chart slides show trends with readable labels and restrained animation.
Final slides connect performance gaps to priorities, owners, and next steps.

output_examples.input: Create an investor pitch for a climate analytics startup.
output: The narrative covers problem, solution, traction, market, product, business model, team, financials, and funding request.
Metrics receive prominent layouts while supporting claims remain concise.
The closing slide states the funding goal and intended use of capital.

best_practices: Provide the audience, objective, slide count, required facts, and desired action.
Verify every metric, quotation, customer claim, and financial projection before publishing.
Replace placeholder content and test the deck at desktop, tablet, and mobile sizes.
anti_patterns: Do not request persuasive claims without supplying evidence or marking assumptions.
Do not place long paragraphs, dense tables, or excessive metrics on one slide.
Do not rely on external assets when the presentation must work offline.

faq.question: What format does this skill produce?
faq.answer: It produces an HTML presentation with CSS and JavaScript for layout, navigation, animation, and optional charts.

faq.question: Can it create PowerPoint files?
faq.answer: No. The provided workflow targets HTML and does not define PowerPoint, Keynote, or Google Slides export.

faq.question: Does it support charts?
faq.answer: Yes. The template supports Chart.js line, bar, doughnut, and radar charts.

faq.question: Will presentations work on mobile devices?
faq.answer: The templates include responsive tablet and mobile breakpoints. Final content still requires testing for overflow and readability.

faq.question: Does the skill need network access?
faq.answer: The default template loads Chart.js from a CDN, and image examples may use external hosts. Local assets can remove this requirement.

faq.question: Which presentation types are supported?
faq.answer: Guidance covers investor pitches, sales decks, product demos, reports, workshops, board meetings, conference talks, case studies, and webinars.
